title: I made a cozy idle factory game
author: PTBurgart
selftext:
It's called Age of Iteration: you start with one campfire and build your way to space and beyond.

How it was made: Claude (Opus) with some Codex first built it as a browser game, \~50k lines of TypeScript in \~500 commits while I played and mentioned what felt wrong. The buildings and nature are GPT image generation that a script scales to the exact pixel size the map draws them at and snaps to one shared palette; roads, carts and the interface are drawn in code.

Then the part I expected to be hard: shipping it. Claude wrapped the game in a Capacitor Android app, and five days later the first build was on Google Play's internal test track. It went through the Play Console sign-up as an organization for my LLC, linked the business payments profile, set up the in-app purchase and Play Games, wrote the store listing, privacy policy and Data safety form, made the screenshots, and it builds, signs and uploads every release. The game went live on Play 2 weeks ago.

This week Opus also made a free browser demo of the first three ages, built the [itch.io](http://itch.io) page and uploaded it, and it updates both stores when updates ship.

What only I could do: apply for the D-U-N-S number, pay Google's $25, accept the terms, do the ID check, and press every button that publishes something. The agents get everything ready and ask me to click it.

Where it stands: about 100 installs on Google Play in 2 weeks and \~400 browser plays from \~600 page views on itch in the 4 days since that page went public. Small numbers, but feels good to share.

Play in the browser: [https://loomfieldlabs.itch.io/age-of-iteration](https://loomfieldlabs.itch.io/age-of-iteration)

Google Play: [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.loomfieldlabs.ageofiteration](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.loomfieldlabs.ageofiteration)
